title: Paneflow configuration
description: Schema for paneflow.json. Lives at ~/.config/paneflow/paneflow.json on Linux, ~/Library/Application Support/paneflow/paneflow.json on macOS, and %APPDATA%\paneflow\paneflow.json on Windows. The runtime is lenient: unknown top-level keys are ignored, so the schema's `additionalProperties: false` is an editor-side aid, not a runtime constraint.

^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*_button_visible$.description: Show the built-in command button of the runtime whose catalog display.visibility_config_key is this key. Null/omitted auto-detects the CLI binary.

$schema.description: Pointer to this schema. Used by editors (VS Code, Zed, JetBrains) for autocomplete and validation. Ignored at runtime.

$schemaVersion.description: Schema version pin. Paneflow logs a warning when the value is unknown but never refuses to load the file.

default_shell.description: Shell binary path. When null or omitted, Unix falls back to $SHELL then /bin/sh. Windows falls back to PowerShell 7 (pwsh.exe), Windows PowerShell 5.1 (powershell.exe), %ComSpec%, C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe, then bare cmd.exe.

theme.description: Bundled theme name: the light or dark variant of one preset (Paneflow, Vercel, Claude, Cursor, Tailwind). Pre-preset names (One Dark, Vercel, Claude, Cursor) still resolve to their variant.

theme_mode.description: Theme selection mode. 'light' and 'dark' force the matching variant of the current preset. 'system' follows the current OS window appearance while keeping theme as the resolved concrete theme for older Paneflow versions.

font_family.description: Font family. Default: bundled JetBrainsMono Nerd Font Mono. Accepts the aliases '.PaneflowMono' and 'JetBrainsMono NFM' for that default, '.PaneflowSans' for bundled Geist, the concrete embedded names ('JetBrainsMono Nerd Font Mono', 'Geist Mono', 'Geist', 'Lilex', 'IBM Plex Mono', 'IBM Plex Sans'), or any installed system monospace family. Unknown families fall back to the default with a warning.

font_fallbacks.description: Ordered fallback font families consulted (in order) for glyphs the primary font_family does not cover - e.g. a Nerd Font for the Powerline/icon glyphs used by Starship, oh-my-posh or Terminal-Icons, which no system font provides on Windows. Null or an empty list keeps GPUI's built-in fallback stack only.

line_height.description: Line height as a multiplier of the font's own line height (ascent + descent + line gap). Default 1.0.

cell_width.description: Cell width as a multiplier of the font's advance. Default 1.0.

unfocused_pane_opacity.description: Opacity of panes that do not hold focus, when a workspace has more than one pane. 1.0 disables the dim. Default 1.0.

reduce_motion.description: Minimize non-essential interface motion: hover transitions settle instantly and decorative animations render a static frame. Default false.

sidebar_show.description: What the workspaces rail shows beyond a row's name. Everything off is the default rail.

branch.description: Show a session tab's git branch: its bound worktree's, or its workspace's when the tab is unbound. Default false.

diffstat.description: Show that same checkout's insertion and deletion counts. Default false.

pr.description: Mark a branch that already has a pull request: its icon becomes the pull-request glyph, colored by the request's state. Needs the 'gh' CLI, and answers for GitHub remotes only. Default false.

indent_guide.description: Draw a hairline under a workspace's folder icon, running down its tab rows. Default false.

editor.description: What the code editor draws beside the text. Toggled from the editor's controls menu.

minimap.description: Draw a minimap of the file along the editor's right edge. Default false.

scrollbar.description: Draw the editor's vertical scrollbar. Default true.

automation.description: Background work Paneflow may run on your behalf after an agent turn.

tab_auto_naming.description: After an agent turn, summarize the conversation into a 2-5 word tab name with the agent's own CLI (claude -p, codex exec, opencode run, pi --print), tools disabled. A name you typed is never replaced. Default false.

worktrees.description: Where Paneflow keeps the git worktrees it creates for branches, and how it cleans them up.

dir.description: Root directory for managed worktrees. Each repository gets a subdirectory named after it, and each branch a directory under that. Empty or null uses the default, ~/.paneflow/worktrees (%USERPROFILE%\.paneflow\worktrees on Windows). '~' expands to the home directory.

auto_remove.description: Remove a managed worktree when its workspace closes, and trim the oldest managed worktrees past keep_limit. Uncommitted changes are saved as a snapshot first, and the branch is never deleted. Default true.

keep_limit.description: Number of managed worktrees to keep before the oldest unopened ones are removed. Default 15.

for_new_branches.description: Default state of the Worktree toggle in the pane palette's New branch form. true creates a worktree for the branch; false switches the workspace checkout to it instead. The toggle rewrites this key. Default true.

window_decorations.description: Window decoration mode. 'client' = client-side decorations (custom title bar). 'server' = server-side decorations (compositor-drawn). Read once at startup; changes require a restart.

window_backdrop.description: Native window backdrop. 'auto' uses Mica on supported Windows 11 builds and opaque elsewhere; 'mica' forces Mica when supported; 'blurred'/'acrylic' opts into blur, except on Windows, where a config value resolves to 'auto' and only PANEFLOW_WINDOW_BACKDROP=blurred applies blur; 'transparent' keeps a transparent surface; 'opaque'/'off' disables native transparency. Read once at startup; PANEFLOW_WINDOW_BACKDROP overrides it for one launch.

windows_terminal_material.description: Windows-only. When true, CLI terminal default backgrounds are transparent so the active native window backdrop (Mica, blur, or transparent) can show through. Other platforms ignore this field.

windows_chrome_material.description: Windows-only. When true, the primary sidebar card reveals the active native window backdrop (Mica, blur, or transparent). Other platforms ignore this field.

macos_chrome_material.description: macOS-only. When true, the primary sidebar card reveals AppKit's native Sidebar material. Other platforms ignore this field.

linux_terminal_material.description: Linux-only. When true, the window surface turns transparent and the terminal card becomes a translucent shade over the window veil, so a compositor blur shows through. Other platforms ignore this field.

linux_chrome_material.description: Linux-only. When true, the window surface turns transparent and the sidebar and title bar show a translucent theme veil, so a compositor blur shows through. Other platforms ignore this field.

option_as_meta.description: Treat Alt/Option as Meta and send an ESC prefix. Default true on Linux and Windows. On macOS, set to false if you rely on Option to produce Unicode characters.

shell_integration.description: Master switch for the per-shell rc injection (OSC 7 CWD reporting + OSC 133 command marks). null/true = enabled (default); false = no snippet is written or wired - the shell starts exactly as it would outside Paneflow.

submit_paste_delay_ms.description: Base delay in milliseconds between writing a bracketed-paste burst to an agent pane and the separate carriage return that submits it (paneflow send --submit). The server then waits for the agent's paste echo before pressing Enter, so this is only the floor. Raise it if a slow agent keeps swallowing the submit. Out-of-range values are clamped.

external_editor.description: Editor used to open file links. 'auto' uses $VISUAL, then $EDITOR, then the first known editor on PATH; 'system' always uses the OS opener. A named editor that is not on PATH falls back to 'auto'.

shortcuts.description: Custom keybindings overriding the defaults. Format: { 'ctrl+t': 'new_tab' }. The full list of action names is defined in src-app/src/app/actions.rs.

ligatures.description: Render programming-font ligatures (FiraCode '=>', '!=', JetBrains Mono, Cascadia Code). Hot-reloaded.

integrated_glyphs.description: Draw built-in block-element glyphs as filled quads instead of using the font glyph. Hot-reloaded.

color_emoji.description: Render emoji with the platform color-emoji path. Hot-reloaded.

scrollbar.description: Show the overlay scrollbar that appears while scrolling or hovering the right edge of a terminal pane. Applied when a terminal view is constructed.

cursor_color.description: Cursor color override as #RRGGBB. Null uses the active color scheme cursor color.

scrollback_lines.description: Maximum scrollback history in lines for normal and agent terminals. Applied to newly-created terminals. Review and cached surfaces cap this value at 2000 and 1000 lines respectively. Live cached/hidden terminals are not rebuilt or killed to shrink history; exited cached terminals may be evicted by the cache policy.

cursor_shape.description: Default cursor shape before an application overrides it.

osc52_clipboard.description: Whether programs may write the system clipboard with OSC 52. copy lets the focused terminal copy; off refuses every OSC 52 write.

xt_checksum_report.description: Answer DECRQCRA checksum requests. Off by default because a running program can checksum the screen one cell at a time and so read back everything on it, including output from other programs.

xt_checksum_extension.description: XTCHECKSUM bits for the DECRQCRA checksum: 1 keeps the result positive, 2 skips video attributes, 4 counts blanks, 8 counts unwritten cells as spaces, 16 uses full codepoints. 0 is the DEC calculation.

env.description: Environment variables injected into every new terminal. Per-surface values win on collision. Protected at PTY spawn: TERM, COLORTERM, TERM_PROGRAM, TERM_PROGRAM_VERSION, SHLVL, PANEFLOW_WORKSPACE_ID, PANEFLOW_SURFACE_ID, PANEFLOW_SOCKET_PATH, PANEFLOW_BIN_DIR, ZDOTDIR, PANEFLOW_ORIG_ZDOTDIR. LD_* and DYLD_* keys and inherited agent session markers are dropped. Each ignored key is logged once. LANG defaults to en_US.UTF-8 only when LANG, LC_ALL, and LC_CTYPE are all unset. PATH is accepted, but PANEFLOW_BIN_DIR is re-prepended so agent commands still route through the shim.

scroll_multiplier.description: Scroll-wheel multiplier outside mouse-reporting and alternate-screen modes. Applied when a terminal view is constructed.

minimum_contrast.description: Minimum APCA lightness contrast (Lc) enforced between text and its cell background, on the colors a program chose (truecolor and palette indices 16 to 255). The theme's own sixteen ANSI colors, foreground and background are never corrected. Unset means Auto, which is 60 on every theme; 0 disables the correction. Hot-reloaded.

commands.description: cmux-compatible command and workspace definitions, rendered in the workspace command palette.

claude_code_bypass_permissions.description: When true, the built-in 'Claude Code' tab-bar button launches the CLI with --permission-mode bypassPermissions, disabling all permission prompts. Per Anthropic's docs this mode offers no protection against prompt injection - opt in only on machines where that risk is acceptable.

ai_unrestricted.description: AI free-access mode. When true, a conductor (a CLI agent or external orchestrator) may auto-submit prompts to other panes (surface.send_text submit:true) WITHOUT the PANEFLOW_IPC_SCRIPTING env gate. Null/false (default) keeps the current behavior strictly unchanged. Re-evaluated per call, so toggling it off revokes the capability with no residual access.

ai_injection_fence.description: Anti-injection fence on the surface.read CLI/IPC path, independent of ai_unrestricted. Null/true (default) wraps returned terminal text in an <untrusted_terminal_output> marker so a malicious peer pane cannot hijack a conductor reading it. False returns raw text (an assumed risk). Stays ON by default even in free-access mode because the fence protects the AI, it does not bridle it.

menu_attention_detection.description: Attention badge for agent-drawn select menus. Claude and Codex numbered prompts fire no lifecycle hook, so the host scans the visible viewport for their footer hints and the worker turns a detected menu into Attention. Null/true (default) keeps the badge; false leaves such a session on its hook- or screen-derived state.

on_quit.description: What quitting the desktop does when hosted sessions are still running. ask (default) opens the quit dialog. keep exits and leaves every session running on the host. stop stops every session, then shuts the host down. With no live session the app always exits and shuts the idle host down.

sidebar_ended_sessions.description: How many ended sessions each workspace previews in the sidebar before the rest collapse under one 'N more ended sessions' row. Ended records are never pruned automatically; the cap only controls the preview. Any other value falls back to 5.

claude_code_button_visible.description: Show the built-in 'Claude Code' command button. Null/omitted auto-detects the CLI binary.

codex_button_visible.description: Show the built-in 'Codex' command button. Null/omitted auto-detects the CLI binary.

opencode_button_visible.description: Show the built-in 'Opencode' command button. Null/omitted auto-detects the CLI binary.

pi_button_visible.description: Show the built-in 'Pi' command button. Null/omitted auto-detects the CLI binary.

hermes_agent_button_visible.description: Show the built-in 'Hermes Agent' command button. Null/omitted auto-detects the CLI binary.

grok_button_visible.description: Show the built-in 'Grok' command button. Null/omitted auto-detects the CLI binary.

amp_button_visible.description: Show the built-in 'Amp' command button. Null/omitted auto-detects the CLI binary.

cursor_button_visible.description: Show the built-in 'Cursor' command button. Null/omitted auto-detects the CLI binary.

gemini_button_visible.description: Show the built-in 'Gemini' command button. Null/omitted auto-detects the CLI binary.

kiro_button_visible.description: Show the built-in 'Kiro' command button. Null/omitted auto-detects the CLI binary.

antigravity_button_visible.description: Show the built-in 'Antigravity' command button. Null/omitted auto-detects the CLI binary.

copilot_button_visible.description: Show the built-in 'Copilot' command button. Null/omitted auto-detects the CLI binary.

codebuddy_button_visible.description: Show the built-in 'CodeBuddy' command button. Null/omitted auto-detects the CLI binary.

factory_button_visible.description: Show the built-in 'Factory' command button. Null/omitted auto-detects the CLI binary.

qoder_button_visible.description: Show the built-in 'Qoder' command button. Null/omitted auto-detects the CLI binary.

openclaw_button_visible.description: Show the built-in 'Openclaw' command button. Null/omitted auto-detects the CLI binary.

deepseek_harness_button_visible.description: Show the built-in 'DeepSeek Harness' command button. Null/omitted auto-detects the CLI binary.

muse_button_visible.description: Show the built-in 'Muse Code' command button. Null/omitted auto-detects the CLI binary.

fx_button_visible.description: Show the built-in 'fx' command button on Linux and macOS. Null/omitted auto-detects the CLI binary.

restore_conversations.description: Reopen each agent conversation in its pane when the hosted session did not survive, for instance after a reboot.

claude_preassign_session_id.description: Have the Claude Code shim pass a generated --session-id to a fresh interactive launch, so the conversation can be reopened even without Paneflow's hooks.

remote_screen_catalog.description: Let the host fetch the signed screen rule catalog from GitHub Releases one minute after it starts and then once a day. false makes no network call; the cached and built-in rules stay active.

agent_profiles.description: Custom launcher entries. Each profile launches one of the built-in agents with extra environment variables and arguments, for example a second Claude Code account through CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR. Profiles appear in the pane palette next to the built-in agents and inherit the base agent's status tracking, hooks, and sessions.

telemetry.description: Opt-in desktop telemetry consent. The first-run consent modal only appears when 'enabled' is unanswered.

enabled.description: Tri-state consent: null = unanswered, true = opted in, false = opted out. The PANEFLOW_NO_TELEMETRY=1 environment variable overrides this unconditionally.

agent.description: Tag of the built-in agent this profile launches.

env.description: Environment variables set on the agent process, not on the shell line. A value starting with ~/ expands to the home directory.

args.description: Extra arguments appended after the base agent's own flags. Each token must be a plain shell word: letters, digits, '-', '_', '.', '='.

commandDefinition.description: Exactly one non-null payload: a workspace definition (set 'workspace') or a non-blank shell command (set 'command').

description.description: Human-readable description shown in the command palette.

command.description: Shell command string. Mutually exclusive with 'workspace'.

cwd.description: Default working directory for the workspace.

layout_preset.description: Visual workspace-builder preset. Mirrors paneflow up layout presets.

color.description: Workspace accent color as a 6-digit lowercase hex string (no leading #).

ratio.description: Legacy single ratio for binary (2-child) layouts. Ignored when 'ratios' is present.

ratios.description: Per-child ratios for N-ary layouts. When present, must match children length and sum to ~1.0.

surface_type.description: Surface kind. Currently only 'terminal' is rendered.

name.description: Display name for the surface tab.

custom_name.description: User-assigned surface name. When set, it overrides the auto-derived surface name and survives restart.

command.description: Shell command to run on surface creation.

prompt.description: Prompt text to prefill after launching an agent command.

cwd.description: Working directory override (relative paths resolve against the workspace cwd).

path.description: File opened by a 'markdown' surface. Ignored by terminal surfaces.

env.description: Extra environment variables merged over terminal.env. The same protected-key and loader-key filtering applies at PTY spawn.

focus.description: When true, this surface receives initial focus.

scrollback.description: Saved plain-text scrollback restored with the surface.

agent.description: Stable tag of the agent CLI last detected in this surface, such as 'claude_code'.

font_size.description: Per-surface font-size override in points. Null follows the global font_size.

session.description: UUID of the persistent host session this terminal surface reattaches to on restore. Written by Paneflow; leave unset in hand-written commands.

agent_session.description: Agent conversation last started in this terminal surface, reported by the agent's SessionStart hook. Paneflow reopens it in the same pane when the host session did not survive. Written by Paneflow; leave unset in hand-written commands.

runtime.description: Catalog id of the agent runtime, such as 'com.anthropic.claude-code'.

id.description: Provider session id of the conversation.

cwd.description: Working directory the conversation was started in.
